messages:
Alex M.: Quick sync — planning a traffic shift for the new open model 'orchid13b-lite' into catalog. Targeting canary tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need to confirm: owners, licensing sign-off, perf profile, and infra gating. PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/infra/serving/PR-4567 :eyes:
Maria L.: Licensing update — Legal gave conditional sign-off. Model weight license is Apache-2.0, but we need to include attribution + link back to original repo in model metadata. I added a note in the intake doc. CC @legal-bot :white_check_mark:
licensing-bot: Legal approval recorded (ticket RL-2024-119). Requirement: metadata field "source_repo" and "attribution" must be non-empty. Automated check will fail otherwise.
Ravi K.: Infra check — we can host canary at 11:00 PT. Need quantization profile + serving config pushed to the canary namespace by 09:30 PT. Also: please avoid large cross-region sync during 08:00-10:30 PT; maintenance window. Added ingress route to staging.
Jen (eng-ml): Perf notes — ran auto-bench on staging image. Median latency looks fine, p95 ~ 85ms with batch_size=8 on our A100 equivalent. Found tokenization mismatch for a small prompt variant that increases tokens by ~3% — I left a comment on PR-4567 with recommended prompt rewrite. Attached perf profile id: pf-2024-11-orchid-lite.
Alex M.: Thanks. Owners to confirm: rollout=Alex M., infra=Ravi K., legal=Maria L., perf=Jen. Sam, any prod constraints?
Sam (prod): Prefer +1h later due to customer job window. 11:00 PT is okay for a short canary, but full traffic shift needs to wait until 13:00 PT if canary goes green. Also request a feature flag + immediate rollback route.
Alex M.: Ok we'll run a 30-min canary at 11:00 PT (5% traffic) then pause for verification. If green, schedule gradual ramp to 50% at 13:00 PT. Rollback plan: toggle feature flag, route back to stable.
Ravi K.: Config snippet I'm going to push to the canary namespace (put under infra/canaries/orchid-lite.yaml):
```
model: orchid13b-lite
quant_profile: q8_4
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  max_batch_size: 8
routes:
  - canary: 0.05
```
I'll open a short PR with that by 09:00 PT.
Maria L.: I'll add the required metadata fields to the model card before 09:30 PT. Also added a short license blurb we can show in the catalog UI.
Jen (eng-ml): I'll push perf profile to the catalog config (pf-2024-11-orchid-lite) and add the perf smoke checks that run during canary. They will fail the rollout if p95 > 140ms or throughput drops > 15%.
Alex M.: Action items checklist:
- Alex M.: kickoff canary job + monitor (11:00 PT)
- Ravi K.: push canary config PR (by 09:00 PT)
- Maria L.: finalize metadata/license blurb (by 09:30 PT)
- Jen: attach perf profile + smoke checks (by 10:00 PT)
- Sam: confirm production rollback hook & flag (done)
I'll post a follow-up with the canary runbook and the datadog dashboard link.
Sam (prod): One more ask — add a short postmortem template to the runbook in case we hit regression. Keep it minimal: timeline, root cause, mitigation.
Alex M.: Will do. Thanks everyone — ping me in thread if anything slips. I'll update the PRs and create the canary run once config PR is merged. :rocket:
